decisions.reason: Fourth rotary axis accessory is a complementary attachment to our core milling machines and builds on established offer.
Hybrid additive post-processing is distant from our core competencies and lacks web presence, so we exit to focus resources.
High-speed CNC milling machine is a core product line close to our established offer and critical for our market position.
Automatic tool change system is complementary to our CNC machines and builds on established engineering.
